One thing to flag: collect.sh bundles your repo, the bare remote, all shell-logs and bash history, and your workspace shells trace every command, so a secret expanded in a traced shell would have ended up in that bundle. I checked before running it — the deploy token isn't in any log, the repo, or the history, because `kg run`'s child shell wasn't traced. Worth knowing that `deploy.sh` does expand `${DEPLOY_TOKEN}` internally, so it would leak if it were ever run from a traced interactive shell instead of via `kg run`.
